mapper.insert: INSERT INTO answer_record (user_id, question_id, category_id, user_answer, is_correct, duration_ms) VALUES (#{userId}, #{questionId}, #{categoryId}, #{userAnswer}, #{isCorrect}, #{durationMs})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM answer_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_correct = 1

SELECT ar.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS name, COUNT(ar.id) AS answered, COUNT(CASE WHEN ar.is_correct = 1 THEN 1 END) AS correct FROM answer_record ar JOIN category c ON c.id = ar.category_id WHERE ar.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY ar.category_id, c.name, c.sort, c.parent_id ORDER BY c.parent_id ASC, c.sort ASC, c.id ASC
